Hi Shawn,

You're right to be angry, and I'm sorry. Your emails should have been answered days ago and they weren't. That's on us, not on you.

Where the order stands: the Bitfortun BS-2 shipped Sep 22 and was delivered Sep 30. The O. add-on on the same order hasn't shipped, it's currently showing October 15.

On the dead unit, the page you found is the right one and the only intake: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform . Fill it in and a prepaid return label comes back to you, and processing is up to 10 days once the unit reaches the warehouse. One thing I have to ask because it decides the cover: was the unit ever run overclocked or modified?

On the refund and on 10 TH/s versus the 8.5 it reports, I'm not going to give you a number I can't stand behind. Both are now in front of Abel and Georges with your order number, and a colleague is picking it up today. The answer comes back to you on this thread.

Nothing needs sending twice, everything you've written is on the order.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Shawn,

No apology needed for the delay, take the time you need. Thanks for the screenshots, they tell me exactly where you are.

Your miner is still on the stock Bitfortun firmware, v1.3, and the latest Harlo OS release for the BS2 is 0.2.101, which is what that page is offering you. Since you are not on Harlo OS yet, you want the full install, not the OTA image. The O. one is only for units already running Harlo OS.

So, on harlolabs.com in Chrome: leave the model on BITFORTUN BS2, tick the box you already ticked, plug the miner into the computer with a USB data cable rather than a charge-only cable, press Connect miner and pick the serial port that appears, then press Erase and install. Leave the USB connected until it finishes. If no port shows up, hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT and try Connect again. The install wipes the saved settings, so you will set the wifi and your pool again afterwards. You do not need the Download buttons at all.

A clean install is the usual fix for a unit that will not hold a pool connection, so it is worth doing before anything else. The C. Protection message on the display is a different thing and I am not going to guess at it. I have put that in front of JD, who handles the hardware, and he will come back to you here. If you want him faster, he is on our Discord as @nullhashrate, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, and he answers there within the hour most days.

If the flash does not bring it to life, the RMA stays open and nothing you do here affects it. And the $200 back on the hashrate difference is still on the table, it just needs a yes from you and the team applies it to the PayPal you paid with.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

One thing still waiting on you whenever you are ready: the $200 on the hashrate difference. Just reply yes here and the team puts it back to the PayPal you paid with.

Hi Shawn,

Unplugging it was the right call. If it is throwing a current protection fault, leave it off, there is nothing to gain by letting it retry.

Hold on the flash for now. JD has your case and he will tell you whether to flash first or treat this as hardware, because if the board is tripping protection, new firmware will not change it and I would rather not have you chasing it twice.

One thing that will speed him up: when you get a moment, send the exact wording on the display when it errors, a photo of the screen is perfect, plus roughly how long it runs from power on before it trips, and whether anything is plugged into the USB port at the time. That usually tells him straight away which way this goes. If you want it sorted faster than email allows, he is on our Discord as @nullhashrate, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, and he will work through it with you live.

And whenever you are ready, a simple yes on the $200 hashrate adjustment and the team sends it back to your PayPal. That one is independent of however the miner turns out.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Shawn,

No rush at all, take the days you need. There is no deadline on the label and nothing expires.

One small thing so the box does not get turned away: the label is USPS, not UPS. Any post office will take it, and you can also just hand it to your regular mail carrier. If getting out is the hard part, you can book a free pickup from your door at usps.com and they will collect it on your next delivery day, so you do not have to go anywhere.

Once it reaches the warehouse we refund the $521.73 to your PayPal, and you will get a note from us when it has gone through.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Shawn,

Please do not buy anything. That is not on you.

The simplest route is to put the two original boxes side by side and tape them firmly together into one solid parcel, then stick the label on the largest flat face. USPS is fine with that as long as it does not flex apart. The overclock package can go back sealed, no need to open it.

If that turns out to be awkward to handle, just say the word and we will send you a second prepaid label so each box travels on its own. Either way there is nothing for you to pay and no box to go out and find.

And remember you can book the free pickup at usps.com so it goes from your door.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
